Team - additional context from LOPs playbook in case its helpful *YTD Gross Compensation* • Defined on Carta as: ◦ Total year-to-date gross compensation earned by the employee ◦ The USD amount used to calculate FICA _before_ any deductions have been applied ◦ YTD Social Security Taxable Wages (Box 3), YTD Medicare Taxable Wages (Box 5) *YTD Supplemental Compensation* • Defined on Carta as: ◦ Total year-to-date supplemental compensation earned by the employee (examples: bonus, stock option income, signing bonus, commission, reimbursement, relocation wages, etc.) *YTD Regular Compensation* • Defined on Carta as: ◦ Total year-to-date regular wages earned by the employee, calculated as YTD Regular + YTD Supplemental = YTD Gross
